source.title: Head of David (plaster cast after Michelangelo, 1890)
source.attribution: Head of David, plaster cast after Michelangelo. 3D scan: SMK - Statens Museum for Kunst, Royal Cast Collection (open.smk.dk), public domain.

frame.units: 1.0 = chin-to-crown head height (vertical); source units per head = 119.4747
frame.axes: +Y up = vertical turn axis; +Z = measured gaze (a camera on +Z at eye height is stared at); +X = Y x Z = the figure's own left. L/R in anchor names = the figure's own left/right.
frame.origin: head centre: halfway between chin and crown, on the turn axis through the neck between the ears
frame.restoreCastPosture: rotate head-space geometry about +X by 8.313 deg to restore the cast's own vertical (the gaze then rises -8.31 deg above horizontal)

bake.ao: channel 0: ambient visibility, 48 cosine-weighted rays per vertex, mean normalised free distance up to 0.25 head units (1 = open, 0 = enclosed)
bake.cavity: channel 1: signed multi-scale curvature, 0.5 = flat, < 0.5 crevice (curl undercuts, eye corners, lid creases, nostrils), > 0.5 ridge/edge; value = 0.5 + 0.5*tanh(c/2.5), c in robust-sigma units
bake.thickness: channel 2: inward free distance along -normal (7-ray 22 deg cone) / 0.12 head units; low = thin (nose wings, ears, lids, curl tips, lips): use for subsurface translucency
bake.skin: channel 3: 1 = broad smooth carved skin (face, neck, chest), 0 = hair/beard/deep carving; use for polish/gloss and SSS strength

notes: Gaze per eye measured relative to the facial symmetry plane (deg, +yaw = figure's left, +pitch = up): {"eyeL": {"yaw": 28.14, "pitch": -7.43}, "eyeR": {"yaw": 1.5, "pitch": -8.76}}.
Facial symmetry plane residual 0.0043 head units (mirror-ICP on the face).
Crop: one horizontal plane at y = -0.85, capped (flat cap facing -Y); keep it out of frame or in shadow.
Turn: yaw about +Y through the origin. The 90-degree turn starts with the camera on the figure's RIGHT (-X side, face pointing screen-right) and ends on +Z (stared at).
Ears: earL measured: most medial point of the ear bowl (concha) seen from the side; earR measured: most medial point of the ear bowl (concha) seen from the side
Head units: 1.0 = 119.475 source units (raw STL units).

Carved heart-shaped pupils: each eye's gaze = eyeball sphere centre -> pupil pit centroid. Michelangelo's eyes diverge (the left eye looks further to his left); +Z is the mean of the two, 14.8 deg to the figure's left of the facial symmetry axis, so at yaw 0 the face is seen slightly turned while the eyes look into the lens.

The cast's gaze runs 8.3 deg below horizontal; head space is levelled (head tipped back by that amount) so the stare is horizontal. frame.restoreCastPosture undoes it (then place the camera below eye level).
Thin plaster mould-seam ridges (cheek, neck, nose bridge) softened with a masked Taubin smooth on broad skin only.

Profile side: the right (-X) side shows the broad chest frontally with the head in profile (the classic view of the SMK photograph). The bust back is hollow (visible from behind and from the far +X side).
